g.aria-label: Naive Attention Moves 4n² Floats Across Slow HBM
Low Arithmetic Intensity: 2n²(d_h + d_v) FLOPs / (4n² · bytes) → (d_h + d_v) / 4 (FP16)
At d_h = d_v = 64 in FP16: Intensity = 32 FLOPs/byte (vs. ~180 FLOPs/byte GPU ridge point)
Naive attention is severely memory-bandwidth bound at every sequence length n!
